scope: Two separate desktop-only final product passes after actual Study publication. All checks use the same strict committed production candidate. Branding and final60s performance/video remain later gates.

pass_1.pixel_review: Red/blue roof bar, steady paused/reduced-motion bar, actual-model thumbnails, guide placement and real Study signs/failures/provenance/downloads inspected. No geometry flicker or clipped controls observed.

pass_2.focus: Desktop layout, recovery, contrast, genuine rendering and camera stability
pass_2.pixel_review: Fourteen-angle contact sheet plus native1440p close view and desktop layout/recovery captures inspected. Roads, hospital grounds, roofs, windows and building bases stay stable without the prior striped depth artifacts; no camera-dependent asset replacement observed.
pass_2.performance_scope: Five-second overview and five-second actual close-follow smoke observations only. These are not the final post-identity benchmark and will not supply README performance claims.

limits: Scoped desktop browser/software checks and manual pixels; not universal traffic-law, accessibility, hardware or real-world safety certification.
